scope: Production Google source, admission, and explicit staff/VPN assignments

repository_tests.command: NGINX_BIN=<local nginx binary> python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v

skipped_test_follow_up.command: DNSMASQ_BIN=<local dnsmasq binary> PYTHONPATH=tests python3 -m unittest test_netbird_dns.DnsTest.test_real_resolver_private_records_and_public_forwarding -v

fixture_api_checks: Production Google bootstrap is idempotent and preserves the local emergency administrator
Only explicitly allowlisted, verified Google accounts pass source admission
Client, issuer, redirect and logout substitution across environments is rejected
Production fixtures and mismatched origin, issuer or subnet fail before API access
Live-policy check failures and fail-open source bindings preserve manual approval
Incomplete Authentik pages and mismatched NetBird connectors/accounts cannot disable approval
Staff app administration does not grant NetBird administration; unrelated groups survive
The CLI selects the production Authentik container and requires an endpoint-matched encrypted token
Real SOPS/age tests reject plaintext, wrong keys and tampered configurations
remaining_identity_gate: Supply the separate production Google client/secrets, validate Google egress, and prove live admission, first-login reconciliation, roles and VPN reachability.
